periods.time: After special conscription ends, before Moroboshi leaves for China

name.en: Sword Eater versus Naniwa Star spar

periods.location: League Japan Branch training arena, Tokyo
periods.summary: Yudai Moroboshi challenges Kuraudo Kurashiki after meeting him at the League branch. Kuraudo's Marginal Counter and vast Orochimaru body counter Moroboshi's range control and Tiger Bite, but Moroboshi develops Blind-Spot Thrust to seal Kuraudo's reflexes and nearly wins. Kuraudo then trusts his violent intuition, adapts Ayatsuji Ten'i Muhou into an offensive pyroclastic-flow style, and defeats Moroboshi with Yamatano Orochi, though Moroboshi's final Unrivaled Single Stroke leaves him frightened.
periods.cause: Moroboshi is in Tokyo to seek Toujin Cup advice from Nango and, finding Kuraudo by chance, wants to test the now-improved Sword Eater before going to China.
periods.process: Kuraudo first slips through spear thrusts and shrugs off Tiger Bite because Orochimaru is enormous and regenerative. Moroboshi endures long-range pressure to map Kuraudo's visual blind spot, uses Blind-Spot Thrust and Hahakiboshi to reverse momentum, then corners him. Kuraudo catches a blind thrust with his teeth, shortens his blades, uses fists and instinct to force through the spear zone, and unleashes dual short-blade offense.
periods.outcome: Kuraudo wins the spar. Observers recognize his dramatic growth, but Kuraudo senses that Moroboshi attempted a terrifying final move that might have changed the result in a life-or-death battle.
periods.significance: Benchmarks Kuraudo above his previous Seven Stars self, introduces Moroboshi's blind-spot thrust and hints at a deeper death-related instinct that links to the volume's theme of suffering and growth.
